title: Beyond Token-Level Guidance: Inference-Time Alignment of Specialized LLMs via Cross-Family Representation Steering
abstract: arXiv:2608.30319v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) finetuned for specialized domains represent crucial high-impact applications. Inference-time alignment improves safety degraded from specialization finetuning without requiring substantial computational resources, complementing finetuning-based methods with an easy-to-use, plug-and-play solution. However, existing inference-time methods fail to reliably improve safety without disrupting domain capability. We identify the root cause as complementary expertise orthogonality: specialized base models and general-domain guidance models have orthogonal competencies, making the guidance signal unreliable for specialized generation. This primarily manifests as stop token interference, where the guidance model's tendency toward continuation overrides the base model's decision to stop, burying correct answers under guidance-induced continuation. translated_title: 超越词元级引导：通过跨家族表示转向实现专用大语言模型的推理时对齐
translated_abstract: 针对专用领域微调的大语言模型（LLM）代表着关键的高影响力应用。推理时对齐（inference-time alignment）无需大量计算资源即可改善因专业化微调而下降的安全性，为基于微调的方法提供了一种易于使用的即插即用补充方案。然而，现有的推理时方法无法在不破坏领域能力的前提下可靠地提升安全性。我们将其根本原因识别为“互补专长正交性”：专用基础模型与通用领域引导模型具有正交的能力，使得引导信号对于专用生成而言不可靠。这主要表现为停止词元干扰，即引导模型倾向于继续生成，覆盖了基础模型停止生成的决策，将正确答案掩埋在引导引起的续写内容之下。为解决这一问题，我们提出了CREST，一种推理时对齐方法（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出CREST方法，通过跨家族表示转向在推理时对齐专用大语言模型，克服引导模型与专用模型之间“互补专长正交性”导致的停止词元干扰问题，在不损害领域能力的前提下可靠提升模型安全性。
en_tdlr: Proposes CREST, an inference-time alignment method via cross-family representation steering that addresses "complementary expertise orthogonality" and stop token interference, reliably improving the safety of specialized LLMs without degrading their domain capability.
